item.title: Targets
item.description: TARGETS is a fascinating, though not entirely successful 1968 movie which stars BORIS KARLOFF in one of his final screen appearances. The post Targets appeared first on David Moody.

item.title: Sunshine
item.description: Of all Danny Boyle's lesser known films, though, I think SUNSHINE is one that warrants being spoken about alongside his best. The post Sunshine appeared first on David Moody.
